description: This Java class, ReportsController, is a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that exposes endpoints for streaming CSV reports based on database views. It provides two GET endpoints: /reports/project-overview and /reports/fund-utilization, both secured via role-based access control and designed to support filtering through query parameters.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing CSV report streaming endpoints with security and filtering capabilities. It depends on ReportService to generate CSV streams based on database views.

methods.name: projectOverviewCsv
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /reports/project-overview, streaming CSV data for project overview, with optional filters for district and status.

methods.name: fundUtilizationCsv
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /reports/fund-utilization, streaming CSV data for fund utilization, with an optional projectCode filter.
